summary: Backend-only testing of Iter 232 city-level category disable gating. Created pytest suite with 22 tests covering: baseline (both cities enabled), Carpentry disabled in Patna + enabled in Ranchi (via live mutation of db.city_pricing with backend restart), and no-city legacy behavior. All 22 tests PASSED. State restored - both Patna and Ranchi have all 7 categories enabled.
critical_code_review_comments: city_pricing_service caches city docs in-process, requiring a backend restart after direct DB edits for cache to clear. Consider adding a short TTL or admin cache-invalidation hook so operators toggling categories via Price Manager UI (which already invalidates) and ops editing DB directly see consistent behavior.

/api/catalog/category/{slug_or_id} returns 200 with city_available=false when disabled - good for banner UX. Verified city name is also returned so the UI can render 'Not available in Patna' correctly.
test_credentials: none required - all catalog endpoints public
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Test fixture temporarily removes Carpentry id from db.city_pricing (patna) and restarts backend; teardown restores it and restarts backend. Verified post-run: Patna=7 categories, Ranchi=7 categories.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run with: cd /app && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://22f741f3-7c36-4160-9943-0a9312895fa6.preview.emergentagent.com MONGO_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017 DB_NAME=test_database python -m pytest backend/tests/test_iter232_city_category_gating.py -v. The fixture mutates db.city_pricing and restarts backend; takes ~15s. Both Patna and Ranchi should have 7 categories including Carpentry (eab6dbbb-8af1-457e-a9d9-ce0bf5abc36d) before test. Carpentry service id used: 121b87c7-7820-4af1-807c-58b04ae44fd3.
rca of the issue: N/A - all gating behavior worked as specified in the review request. Endpoints correctly honor the per-city categories whitelist for: /catalog/categories, /catalog/services (list+detail), /catalog/category/{slug}, /catalog/addons, /ratecards/by-category, /ratecards/by-service, /ratecards/search; and legacy no-city requests remain unaffected.
